xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Summary update is awaited before evaluating extraction cadence; the two feature flags are independent.
Answer RPC completes before Conversation assistant persistence and completed-turn event; memory-writer completion is not awaited by answer delivery.
Provider failures keep prior summary or empty extraction; writer errors log/skip without undoing the saved assistant.
Memory validation uses user-only source evidence; assistant output is not accepted as user evidence.
